name: capture
description: Stateless capture-parsing service. Text and a schema in, candidate items out. Stores nothing.

scripts.test:
tsx --test tests/auth.test.ts tests/callers.test.ts tests/contract.test.ts tests/schema.test.ts && echo '
  NOT RUN: the two acceptance tests (tests/acceptance.test.ts and
  tests/acceptance-2.test.ts). They call the real model and cost money.
  Green above does not mean they pass. Run them with
  npm run test:acceptance:all
'
scripts.test:acceptance:all: npm run test:acceptance && npm run test:acceptance2
